messages:
deploy-bot: automated rollback triggered for rollout v5.2.0 -> trigger: request-5xx spike (>3% for 10m). scheduling rollback to v5.1.7 and starting traffic reassign. :rotating_light:
rachel: pause the global rollback 1. FinanceEdge (EU tenant) reported 500s only on their namespace; they asked us to keep their canary live for trace capture. can we do a targeted suppression and pin tenant traffic?
omar: +1. plan: cancel remaining global rollback steps, pin tenant routes to v5.1.7 for production endpoints, keep a 7% tenant-scoped canary on v5.2.0 to gather full payloads, increase trace sampling.
ops-oncall: rollback job 1744009999 is 38% complete. queued ops: LB weight shifts and host drains in eu-west-3. need explicit approval to cancel.
deploy-bot: rollback job paused awaiting manual override; automated guard suppression requires approver tag.
vivek: I approve targeted suppression for FinanceEdge. ops-oncall cancel remaining global rollback and run `deployctl pin --tenant financeedge-eu --version v5.1.7 --reason "tenant debug window"` and `deployctl tenant-canary --tenant financeedge-eu --version v5.2.0 --percent 7`
ops-oncall: executed: `deployctl cancel 1744009999` -> success; `deployctl pin --tenant financeedge-eu --version v5.1.7 --reason "tenant requested suppression"` -> success (audit pin-ff12); `deployctl tenant-canary --tenant financeedge-eu --version v5.2.0 --percent 7` -> success. suppression window set to 2h, auto-rollback re-enable scheduled at 1744017199 unless extended.
isabel: ML/infra tasks: take KV snapshot `kv-pre-174400`, enable 100% trace sampling for financeedge-eu for 1h, add model debug headers, and preserve canary logs for 72h. creating INC-2024-3401 and assigning eng-runtime + eng-ml.
rachel: I'll send a short message to FinanceEdge PM: "We're investigating intermittent 5xx for some requests. Your production traffic will remain stable; we will capture traces and update by EOD."
isabel: initial trace peek shows tail latency and sporadic decoder OOMs on host set h-psi-03; correlation with KV miss spikes. starting repro against canary hosts.
omar: if we confirm a model-artifact regression, prefer model-only revert on canary hosts + quick canary validation, not a full infra rollback.
ops-oncall: retention and tags applied: logs retained 72h, tag `financeedge-canary-174400`. watch timer set.
deploy-bot: suppression recorded by vivek; audit id a9c4.
isabel: incident created INC-2024-3401 with traces attached; linking here.
rachel: closing loop for now 1 team will monitor canary, ML to report repro status, support will keep customer updated. if we need to flip global traffic later we will run full rollback checklist and notify stakeholders before action. :white_check_mark:
